fixtures.pattern: A positive issuer-level anchor and one current or economically independent corroborating fact establish direction, while material limitations leave no broader stronger support.

Distinct current operating improvement, cash-conversion improvement, and balance-sheet resilience materially strengthen breadth and quality; limitations remain but do not make adjacent buckets genuinely ambiguous.
fixtures.reason: This is stronger current support beyond minimum BUY.

fixtures.pattern: Multiple positive economic axes exist, but an unresolved causal or persistence issue directly threatens whether the observed improvement represents durable support.
fixtures.reason: The existing adjacent-bucket tie-break selects the less directional bucket.

fixtures.pattern: Strong distinct current operating, cash-conversion, and balance-sheet support is established; safe valuation is the only missing domain.
fixtures.reason: Valuation absence limits conviction but is not a universal stronger-bucket cap.

fixtures.pattern: Strong distinct current fundamental support is established and expectations are elevated, but the expectation evidence does not establish current deterioration or a valuation conclusion.
fixtures.reason: Elevated expectations are a caution whose economic force is evaluated in context, not an automatic downgrade.

fixtures.pattern: A negative issuer-level material anchor and sufficiently current or economically independent corroboration establish minimum negative direction.
fixtures.reason: This is minimum directional support on the symmetric negative side.

fixtures.pattern: Distinct current operating deterioration, cash-conversion deterioration, and balance-sheet fragility materially strengthen negative breadth and quality beyond minimum direction.
fixtures.reason: This is stronger negative support under the symmetric contract.

fixtures.pattern: Multiple negative economic axes exist, but an unresolved causal or persistence issue directly leaves minimum and stronger SELL buckets genuinely adjacent.
fixtures.reason: The existing adjacent-bucket tie-break selects the less directional bucket.
